Small JPEGs carrying each EXIF orientation value (o1.jpg through o8.jpg),
written by exiftool 12.29 so the parser is checked against a real EXIF writer
rather than only against test-generated bytes. They use big-endian byte order
and a five-entry IFD0, unlike the single-entry little-endian files the unit
tests build in memory.

Regenerate with:

    exiftool -overwrite_original -Orientation#=<n> o<n>.jpg
